trigger.first_failure: The official SpreadsheetML structural tags use the ss namespace prefix; the parser originally recognized only unprefixed local tag names.
trigger.second_failure: Two Historical rows contain the exact Shares Outstanding placeholder token -- and therefore cannot be normalized as numeric issuer observations.

frozen_normalization_rule.allowed_only_when: Shares Outstanding equals the exact placeholder token and the issuer as-of date is strictly before 2025-07-28.
frozen_normalization_rule.normalization: Exclude an allowed placeholder row from the shares-outstanding observation sequence without imputing, forward-filling, backfilling, or converting it to zero.
frozen_normalization_rule.sequence_semantics: The immediately prior and next rows containing finite positive whole-unit shares become consecutive valid issuer observations, consistent with the preregistered rule not to fabricate weekend or holiday observations.
technical_failure_conditions: any Shares Outstanding placeholder on or after 2025-07-28
any placeholder token other than the exact string --
any nonfinite, nonpositive, or fractional numeric shares value
any missing or invalid NAV value
any duplicate or unordered as-of date
manifest_requirements: retain the exact raw workbook bytes
record excluded placeholder count and exact dates
bind this addendum by path, byte count, and SHA-256

risk_and_falsifier.risk: Excluding missing-share rows connects valid observations across an unobserved interval; this could matter to a persistence signal if such a gap occurred near the tested window.
risk_and_falsifier.mitigation: Both observed placeholders precede the first frozen market partition by more than one year, and any placeholder within or after the frozen window remains a technical failure.
risk_and_falsifier.falsifier: A source-bound inspection finds another missing-share row, a placeholder on or after 2025-07-28, a different placeholder token, or any candidate outcome was inspected before this rule was frozen. Any such finding invalidates this addendum and stops the experiment.
